source.name: Footy Headlines: Tunisia 2026 World Cup Home, Away & Third Kits Released
source.note: Kit maker. The launch write-up and its product photos (front and back) show only the Kappa Omini and the Tunisia crest on the white home shirt, with no commercial logo on the front, sleeves or back (a small Tunisian-flag tab sits at the nape); the shorts carry only the federation crest and a Kappa Omini, with no commercial logo (Kappa's own product photos). No other sponsor could be found on any placement.
source.quote: The central Kappa Omini logo and the traditional Tunisia national team crest are rendered in bold red.

summary: Kappa home kit for the 2026 World Cup. No commercial shirt sponsor: the Kappa Omini and the Tunisia crest are the shirt's only marks, on front, sleeves and back; the shorts carry only the federation crest and a Kappa Omini.
headline: The shirt is {level}: it carries no commercial sponsors. Kappa makes the kit.
